# nsh-gallery-ui

The repository's internal UI layer for the TSX gallery and the website's runnable demos. It composes `nsh/base`
and NSH's elements; it is maintained with these examples, rather than published as an application API.

| File | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| `theme.json` | The canonical light/dark design tokens, referenced by both apps' `nsh.json`; `scrim` is the one dimming behind every modal overlay; `hover` (`hover:bg-hover`) is the text color at 5%, so it shows over every surface (a raised control keeps `finish.hover`: a fill would replace its own); `track` and `knob` are a switch's or a slider's off track and knob, and in dark follow shadcn/ui's: a light knob on a track a step above the card, never darker than the page; `raised` is the same color as `finish.raised` |
| `finishes.json` | Surface gradients, shadows and glass finishes used by NSH and HTML; `on` is what stays on (a toggle, a chosen tool), a fill that stands off its surface further than a hover in both appearances; `thumb` is a segmented control's or a tab strip's raised segment, white with a firmer edge in light so it stands off its track; `groove` the lip of light under a menu's separator |
| `theme.ts` | Reactive palette roles, finish accessors, radii, focus/hover feedback, motion and `follow` (a value springing to a control's state); `toneTint` (a tone's translucent tint) and `solidTint` (the same, opaque on a given surface, for what overlaps: stacked avatars) |
| `index.tsx` | Shared buttons, the gallery's `Card` (on `sectionSurface`), badges, the gallery's `Toggle`, sheets and presentation helpers; re-exports the looks |
| `look/button.ts` | What a button looks like, spread on `nsh/base`'s `Button` (or a pressable `View`): `buttonLook` (kinds, sizes, the selected, hover, pressed, focus and disabled states, the press's native sink, a hit slop to 44 points on touch screens), `buttonLabel`, `buttonGlyph`, `buttonSizes`, the icon-only and round buttons' `iconButtonLook` / `roundButtonLook`, and `splitButtonLook` (a main action and its menu in one silhouette: the frame, two halves shading under the pointer and pressed, the hairline between them); the gallery's `Button`, `RoundButton`, icon buttons and split button and the demos' `button()` use it |
| `look/switch.ts`, `look/switch-geometry.ts` | What a switch looks like, spread on `nsh/base`'s `Switch`: `switchLook` (the sunk track turning citrus, the knob springing across natively, white with an olive edge on (`finish.knobOn`)) and `switchHitSlop` (a hit slop to 44 points on touch screens, for a switch that stands alone, not one that is a row with its label); its sizes, the knob's travel (the same gap to the track's edge on and off) and the slop are plain arithmetic in `switch-geometry.ts`, which `website/tests/gallery-ui-switch.test.ts` checks; the gallery's `Toggle` and switch rows and every website demo's `Switch` use it |
| `look/press.ts` | A press's native feedback: `pressSink(scale)` (an `activeStyle` sinking the control, none with reduced motion, and the `style` transition that eases it), `pressTransition`, `pressEasing` (150 ms, ease-out); the button looks, `Press` and `tabPress` use it |
| `look/tool.ts` | What a toggle and a toolbar's tools look like, spread on `nsh/base`'s `Toggle` (or a toolbar's `Button` or popup trigger, with `on`): `toggleLook` (`ghost` or `outline`, sizes, the on fill `finish.on` as `pressedStyle`, hover, the press's native sink (`look/press.ts`), focus, disabled, a hit slop to 44 points on touch screens), `toggleLabel`, `toggleGlyph`, `toggleSizes`, and the inset track and hairline of a toolbar: `toolbarTrack`, `toolbarRule`; the gallery's Toggle and Toolbar demos and the demos' toggles use it |
| `look/menu.tsx` | What a menu looks like, spread on `nsh/base`'s `MenuItem` and given to its `Menu` / `ContextMenu` / `Submenu`: `menuItemLook` (the row, its hover and keyboard highlight alike in the neutral `accent` (`menuHighlight`), pressed (`menuPressed`), disabled), `menuItemLabel`, `menuItemNote`, `menuItemGlyph`, `menuItemSize`, `menuPopup` (spread on the menu: the popup surface coming in from the trigger's side, on the popup's own box around the items it scrolls, a touch screen's sheet and its scrim), `menuSeparator` (a groove), and the parts `MenuLabel` (a group's title), `SubmenuRow` and `SubmenuBack`; the gallery's menus (Menu, Toolbar, Button, Pagination demos) and the website's `el-menu` use it |
| `look/overlay.ts` | What the other overlays look like: `backdrop()` (the theme's `scrim`, every modal's), `tooltipLook` / `tooltipText` / `tooltipNote` (the `popover` bubble, not inverted), `popoverLook` (a popover's or a hover card's surface on `popupSurface`), `sheetPanel` / `sheetGrabber` (a sheet's panel at each edge), `dialogCard` / `dialogTitle` / `dialogText` (a card dialog: the card's surface and edge, `finish.menu`'s shadow, 16-point corners, 20 points of padding), and a toast's `toastLook`, `toastTitle`, `toastText`, `toastActionLook` / `toastActionLabel` (the citrus button) and `toastCloseLook`; the gallery's `Tip`, `Sheet`, toasts and overlay demos and the website's overlay demos use it |
| `look/surface.tsx` | Surfaces and rows: `density` and `controlSize` (pointer and touch sizes; touch rows are 44 points), `sectionSurface` (a flat card: surface fill, hairline border, the density's corners, no shadow; `padded` adds its padding), `insetSurface` (a sunk well), `plainRow` (a settings row with a hairline above all but the first; a `wide` control, a combobox, goes under its label in a narrow window, `narrowWindow`: a phone or a narrow desktop window), `listRow` (a pressable row whose `accent` hover reaches 8 points past both sides, with press, focus and disabled feedback), `RowDivider` (a hairline inset on both sides), `RowLabel` (a row's label and quieter detail, wrapping rather than cut short), `labelColumn`; the gallery's `Card`, its control demos' rows and the website demos' cards and settings rows use them |
| `look/choice.tsx` | What a checkbox and a radio look like: `checkboxLook` (the indicator's sunk well and its press), `CheckboxMark` (the check or dash springing in), `RadioRing` (the ring and its growing dot), `choiceWell`, `ChoiceLight` and `choiceTileLook` (a choice card, accent-tinted when chosen); the gallery's Checkbox, Radio and Accordion demos and the website's `el-checkbox` / `el-radio` use them |
| `look/tabs.tsx` | What tabs and segmented controls look like: `segmentedLook` (track, sliding `finish.thumb` indicator, segments and labels), `tabsLook` (a capsule strip), `underlineTabsLook` (an accent underline over a hairline rule) and `TabTitle` (an icon, a title and a count); `segmented.tsx`, the gallery's Tabs demo and the website's `el-tabs` / `el-radio` use them |
| `look/field.tsx` | What text fields look like: `fieldLook` (a recessed well around an input and its affixes: a stronger edge under the pointer, the danger tone while invalid, flat while read-only or disabled, and the one focus look of every field, a 2-point accent edge, the border and the outline together, while the input has the keys; `edgeClass` writes these edges as classes, so the focus edge holds under the pointer), `fieldText` (the input's text, caret and selection in it), `inputLook` (both on a lone `Input`; the demos' `field()`), `fieldSize`, and the class-drawn wells with the same focus edge: `numberInputClasses` / `numberInputSteps` / `numberInputText`, `timeFieldClass`, `otpCellLook`; the gallery's Form fields, number inputs, codes and time fields and every website demo's inputs use them |
| `look/listbox.tsx` | What lists of choices look like: `Picker` / `pickerLook` (a select's or date picker's trigger: the raised finish, its open and invalid edges after the finish, the fields' focus edge, a placeholder in the muted color, an optional leading `icon`), `DateTrigger` (a date picker's trigger after shadcn/ui's: led by a calendar, no chevron), `Chevron`, `listboxPopup` / `listboxProps` (a popup that extends the trigger: the raised finish, corners of 10, 6 points of padding; a sheet on a touch screen), `optionClass` / `OptionRow` (rows lit in the brand tint, the chosen one bolder with a check), `ListboxHeader` (sentence case), `ListboxEmpty`, `listboxFooter`, `listboxSearch`, `clearButtonLook`, `comboboxLook` (a placeholder summing up the chosen values, `filled`, in the text color) / `ComboToggle`, and the calendar after shadcn/ui's: `CalendarItem` (32-point cells with a pointer, ghost arrows at the header's ends around a centered title, two-letter weekdays, today, the hover and a range's band on the text color at 8% (shadcn's `accent`, which holds in dark), the selection on `primary`, the band rounding at the weeks' ends, the keyboard's day in a soft ring), `TimeSegment`, `calendarLook` and `datePickerLook`; the gallery's Select, Combobox and DatePicker demos and the website's `el-select`, `el-combobox`, `el-date-picker` use them |
| `look/meter.ts` | What a progress bar looks like, spread on `nsh/base`'s `Progress`: `progressLook` (the slider's sunk rail, its citrus run or a tone, gliding to each value on a 180 ms curve, or a third sweeping across while indeterminate), `progressSweep` (that sweep, looped natively), and the parts `progressRail`, `progressFill`, `progressGlide`, `progressRemaining`; the gallery's Progress demos and `Meter` and the website's Progress demo use it |
| `look/disclosure.tsx` | What an accordion's and a collapsible's parts look like: `disclosureTriggerLook` (the list's row, `listRow`, as the `group` its chevron follows), `DisclosureChevron` (turning as the item opens), `disclosurePanel` (the content's padding); the gallery's Accordion and Collapsible demos and the website's use it |
| `look/nav.tsx` | What the navigation controls look like: a carousel's arrows (`carouselArrowLook`, raised or glass over a photo), pagination dots (`carouselPaginationLook`, `carouselDotItemLook`, `CarouselDot`) and `carouselSizes`; a link's color (`linkColor`), its own look (`linkLook`) and its text with the underline that grows under the pointer (`LinkText`); a pagination's items (`paginationItemClass`, 44 points on a touch screen, the current page lit as a primary button) and its chevrons for Previous and Next (`paginationArrows`, its `renderItem`); the gallery's Carousel, Link and Pagination demos and the website's use it, and scroll bars take `scrollbar-theme.ts` |
| `look/plot.ts` | What a plot looks like: the series' and categories' colors (`seriesColors`, `seriesColor`, `categoryColors`), the grid, baseline and reference lines, the cross line (`plotCrossLine`), the hover's dot, an area's wash, the axes' text and the tooltip's card; each reads the theme where it is drawn; the gallery's Charts and the website's plot demos use it |
| `look/workspace.tsx` | What the workspace components look like: a `ResizablePanelGroup`'s handles (`resizableHandleLook`, `resizableHandle`), a `DockArea`'s parts (`dockClasses`), tabs (`DockTab`, `dockTabCloseClass`) and drag preview (`DockDragPreview`), a `DiffView`'s colors of change in the up and down tones (`diffViewStyles`) and its compact Revert and Keep on a change, backed by the row's color (`DiffHunkActions`, `diffHunkTone`), a `RichEditor`'s document (`richEditorClasses`), a `TextView`'s links and streaming caret (`textViewLinkClasses`, `textViewCaretClass`); the gallery's Resizable, Dock, Editor, RichEditor and TextView demos and the website's use it |
| `look/color.tsx` | What a color picker looks like, laid out as ReUI's: the area and sliders (`colorAreaLook`, `colorSliderLook`, `colorChecker`), the eyedropper and copy buttons (`ColorDropper`, `ColorCopy`), the format's fields joined in one well with a menu of the formats (`ColorFields`), preset swatches (`ColorSwatches`), the whole panel (`ColorPanel`), the field-like trigger of a popover, as a select's (`ColorTrigger`) and the picker in a popover under it (`ColorPopover`); the gallery's ColorPicker demo and the website's use it |
| `color-format.ts` | A picked color written in any of the picker's formats (`formatColor`, as `nsh-base` writes it) and the ink that reads on it (`inkOn`): content, not the interface's look |
| `popup.tsx` | The popup families' one surface and their enter motion (`PopIn`, `createPresence` for tooltips), and `MenuMark` / `menuIndicator`: a checkable menu item's check or dot and the indicator part it follows |
| `sound.ts` | The gallery's sounds, by job (`tap`, `select`, `toggle`, `open`, `close`, `success`, `warning`, `error`, `ready`, `attention`: cuelume's cues, MIT, in `examples/gallery/sounds`): `loadSounds` takes the app's own files, `play` plays one quietly unless the user turned them off (`soundsOn`, `setSoundsOn`, kept in `Storage`); the `Toggle`, `Segmented` and `Sheet` sound with it, and so do the gallery's toasts, chat and controls |
| `segmented.tsx` | `Segmented`, the segmented control shared by the gallery and demo inspectors, on `segmentedLook` |
| `icons.tsx` | The common line icon set, `IconLabel` (an icon-only control's icon, its short label as text in the terminal), and `CheckMark`: the check of checkboxes, selects and menus as an SVG image |
| `data-table.ts` | Compact table spacing, resize separators, sort chevrons and selection feedback; the table on the card's color, its header and stripes muted |
| `scroll-area.tsx` | The scroll bar's track and thumb, and `ScrollArea`: a scroll view with that bar in place of the platform's indicator |
| `command.tsx` | A `Command`'s parts: `commandClasses` (frame, search bar, rows with hover, highlight and disabled feedback, headings, separators), `CommandRow` (icon, label, detail, note, the shortcut's `CommandKeys`, a check), `CommandHeading`, `CommandEmpty` |
| `emoji.tsx` | An `EmojiPicker` after Slack's (desktop) and the iOS keyboard's (phone): `emojiPickerClasses`, the groups' names and tab icons, `EmojiTabs` (on `Tabs`), `EmojiTones` (the skin tone hand and its six tones), `EmojiPreview`, `EmojiHeading`, and `EmojiPanel` that puts them together |
| `tree.tsx` | A `Tree`'s rows: `treeItemClass` (hover, selected, focus and disabled feedback) and `TreeRow` (the chevron and folder that open with the row, the label indented by depth) |
| `avatar.ts` | Avatars' identity colors (an OkLCH hue per name, as gpui-component's), the GitHub pictures of NSH's maintainers (`avatarPortrait`) and an image that never loads |
| `slider.ts` | The slider's rail, gradient fill, pill thumb, value column and state feedback |
| `palette.ts`, `demo.ts` | The documentation demos' palette adapter, `size` (rows and their type from `controlSize`), `button()` / `buttonText()` (`buttonLook` with the demos' options), `field()` (`inputLook`), and stage, inspector, panel and log components |
| `css.js` | CSS variables for the website, generated from the same theme and finish data |

The gallery imports through `examples/gallery/ui.tsx`; that file keeps its navigation, sidebar state, branded
header and lazy demo loading. Website demos import through `website/demos/palette.ts`. Those adapters keep
application state outside this layer while existing demo imports keep working.
The website's Vite plugin consumes `css.js`; its page CSS aliases these variables rather than keeping another
palette and another copy of the shared surface finishes.

Shared looks live in `look/`, modules per control family (`.ts`, or `.tsx` when a look draws a part, as `look/menu.tsx`) that import only `../theme`, the popup surface and icons (`../popup`, `../icons`), each other and `nsh` / `nsh/*`, so the playground can include them; one name is never both a `.ts` and a `.tsx`. A look returns the props to spread on the `nsh/base` component (`style`, `hoverStyle`, `activeStyle`, `focusStyle`, `disabledStyle`, `hitSlop`), its colors getters that follow the theme; a state's border or fill goes after the finish it changes. Colors come from the theme's tokens and finishes: `website/tests/gallery-ui-colors.test.ts` rejects color literals in the looks, the demo adapters and the website's demos (a demo whose colors are its content, a photo's caption or a color picker's swatches, is listed with why), and a website demo's `Switch` that styles its track or thumb in place instead of spreading `switchLook`, a `Toggle` without `toggleLook`, a `Checkbox` without `checkboxLook`, `Tabs` without a tab look, an `Input`, `ColorField`, `Select`, `Combobox`, `DatePicker`, `NumberInput` or `OtpInput` without its field or listbox look, a card that spreads `ui().card` with corners of its own (before the spread or after it) instead of `sectionSurface()`, and a progress bar, accordion trigger, carousel dot, link, pagination, scroll bar, plot cross line, resizable handles, dock or rich editor that does not take its shared look.

Add or change a shared visual rule here. Keep layout, interaction and accessibility in `nsh/base`; colors, padding,
borders, surfaces and state feedback belong here. Preserve a component's iconography when changing spacing or
moving its styles. Apps can override the shared parts to demonstrate customization.

Normal builds follow these source imports with the NSH bundler. The website playground's single-module compiler
uses `website/src/lib/inline-gallery-ui.ts`: it includes the imported shared modules in isolated scopes and applies
this same theme before the first render. Changes to shared source should be checked in both the gallery and a
website demo, in light and dark appearance, including the playground.

## Visual bar

Every example must be beautiful and refined: theme tokens for color, photographs or restrained gradients rather than
saturated placeholder tints, nothing clipped, even spacing. See "Gallery examples must be beautiful and refined" in
`AGENTS.md`.
